svg.title: A beta of a Nextcloud app reaches only its testers
svg.desc: The beta v1.5.0-beta.1 tags main, whose appinfo/info.xml still says 1.4.0. The build writes 1.5.0-beta.1 into the info.xml of the package before it signs it, and checks the signed package. The delivery checks the version again and posts the package as no nightly. The App Store adds the release 1.5.0-beta.1 beside 1.4.0, which Nextcloud offers only to servers on the beta channel, while every other server keeps 1.4.0.
